positive: Diagnose a reproducible regression whose root cause is unknown.
Investigate a test failure after several unsuccessful fixes.
Write the postmortem for a production failure once its root-cause is found.
Weigh competing hypotheses for a flaky failure and kill one with an experiment.
near_negative: Implement an already specified change with a known mechanism.
Brainstorm an uncommitted product idea before it has any defined shape.
Ship a fully specified change using an already-agreed approach.
Cut a release: bump the version number and publish the changelog.
Record a session handoff checkpoint before stopping work for the day.
Draft user-facing release notes from the merged changelog fragments.

behavior_assertions.assert: Each attempted fix is tied to a falsifiable hypothesis and fresh evidence.
A postmortem runs the six-step RCA checklist, and a record that skips a step is incomplete.

check.command: python scripts/godmode.py --project . checklist template rca --for postmortem

behavior_assertions: A hypothesis repeated unsuccessfully three times triggers an architectural reassessment.
